observations: Photo 0: white tabletop sewing machine with 'TOYOTA' logo on the body, sitting on a dark table, metal roofing sheet in background.
Photo 1: closer view of the same machine showing stitch-selector dial, handle, thread guide, and power switch; brand 'TOYOTA' clearly visible in red.
No model number, serial plate, or rating label visible in either photo.
No power cord, foot pedal, or accessory box shown in either photo.
Machine body shows some surface dirt/smudges near the needle area and handle.
No video or audio evidence of the motor running.

claims.evidence: Toyota is a known Japanese brand, but no country-of-manufacture marking is visible in either photo; could be made under license elsewhere.
No video or audio clip showing the machine powered on; photos are static.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No accessories, manual, pedal, or cord are visible in either photo.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service history cannot be confirmed from photos; this is a seller statement only.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or motor may be faulty
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine plugged in, switched on, and stitching a test piece

risks.risk: Missing foot pedal or power cord, which are essential for operation
risks.proof: A photo showing the pedal and cord laid out next to the machine
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, lowering value toward the low end

risks.risk: Missing or substituted accessories/manual despite claim
risks.proof: A photo of the accessory box and manual with the machine's brand visible
risks.if_unproven: priced without added value for accessories

risks.risk: Internal wear, rust, or needle plate damage not visible from exterior angles
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the bobbin area, needle plate, and underside
risks.if_unproven: priced at base condition, no premium for 'like new' internals

proof_requests: Video of the machine running a stitch on fabric
Photo of the power cord and foot pedal
Photo of the accessory box and manual showing matching brand
Close-up of the underside/bobbin area for wear or rust
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type and brand (Toyota tabletop sewing machine) even without a model number, and all seller claims (working motor, Japanese origin, full accessories) are unverified from photos alone, so it must be priced at worst case as a basic, unproven-working portable sewing machine rather than a premium manual/electric, embroidery, or industrial unit.
